identity_cost.detail: a Brazilian tax number plus a credit card: billing data requires 'Nome completo ou razao social', 'CPF ou CNPJ valido', 'Endereco de faturamento' and 'Cartao de credito valido', and the CPF/CNPJ cannot be changed after registration. notes: The R$ 300 seller credit is the larger number and it is institution-gated twice: an active Marketplace seller account and a CNPJ. The free-egress term is the real prize here, because it removes the usual per-GiB egress cost on a regional cloud; it is stated as currently free rather than contractually free, so it can be withdrawn at any time. A Brazilian CPF is obtainable by a resident only; that is what makes this fails-identity rather than qualifies-with-caveat.
